reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Light Cleansing Oil 200mL
reviews.text: This cleansing oil is a holy grail product! It removes all my makeup, including waterproof mascara, without any harsh rubbing. My skin feels so clean but never stripped or tight afterward. I have sensitive skin and this has never caused any irritation - the centella really seems to soothe. The texture is perfect - not too thick, not too thin. Will definitely keep repurchasing!
reviews.zh: 呢支卸妝油係必買聖品！唔使大力捽就清走晒所有妝容，包括防水睫毛液。用完之後皮膚感覺非常乾淨，但又唔會被抽乾或繃緊。我皮膚敏感，但呢支從來冇引起過刺激——積雪草真係睇落有舒緩效果。質地完美——唔會太稠亦唔會太稀。一定會繼續回購！

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Light Cleansing Oil 200mL
reviews.text:
Es mi primer limpiador en aceite y puedo decir que es perfecto, lo compré para comenzar a hacer doble limpieza y el resultado me encanta, tengo menos puntos negros y mis poros se han ido cerrando.

Otra cosa que amo de este limpiador es su olor, es delicioso, al hacer la espuma huele como a naranja/ cítrico. Además no arde ni es oclusivo.

Lo volveré a comprar, se está convirtiendo en uno de mis favoritos 🫶
reviews.zh:
呢支係我第一款卸妝油，我可以講係完美。我買佢係為咗開始做雙重清潔，效果我好喜歡，黑頭少咗，仲覺得毛孔慢慢收緊。

另一樣我愛嘅係佢嘅味道，超好味，搓到起泡嗰陣有橙／柑橘嘅香味。而且唔拮眼又唔會封閉毛孔。

我會再回購，佢而家變成我嘅最愛之一 🫶

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Light Cleansing Oil 200mL
reviews.text: I’m not a fan of cleansing oils since I have an acne prone skin but this product not only well removes makeup but also doesn’t clog my pores. Therefore, it didn’t break me out. It has slight centella fragrance but for me it isn’t critical. Cleansing oil doesn’t tighten or dry my skin. Additionally, it’s great for sensitive skin and doesn’t irritate it. Overall I would recommend it
reviews.zh: 因為我係容易爆瘡嘅膚質，所以我一向唔太鍾意卸妝油，但呢件產品唔止卸得乾淨妝容，仲唔會堵塞毛孔。所以佢冇令我爆瘡。佢有少少積雪草香味，但對我嚟講唔算重要。卸妝油唔會令我皮膚繃緊或乾燥。再加上，佢對敏感肌好啱用，唔會刺激。整體嚟講我會推薦。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Light Cleansing Oil 200mL
reviews.text: This is the first cleansing oil I tried and I was very impressed. I initially was nervous to try cleansing oil because I’m prone to breakouts and oily skin, but I honestly think this helped balance my skin and unplugged my pores very well. On days where my skin is feeling a little dry with my acne medication, using this is really helpful to calm my skin, yet thoroughly cleanse it.
reviews.zh: 呢支係我試過嘅第一款卸妝油，印象非常深刻。本來因為我容易爆瘡同油性肌，對試卸妝油有啲緊張，但我真心覺得佢有助平衡皮膚，清毛孔清得好好。有啲日子用完暗瘡藥皮膚會有啲乾燥，用呢支真係有助鎮靜皮膚，同時深層清潔。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Light Cleansing Oil 200mL
reviews.text: I was not sure about cleansing oils because I’ve seen that many people’s skin breakout, and I read all the reviews and they said this is one of the most gentle oil cleansers and I decided to try it. I have combination skin and did not breakout at all. The only thing is that I only use it once a week when I do my “heavy” makeup and it takes all the dirt from your skin. I wash it off with warm water and it helps better to wash away all the product. After using it the skin felt so soft, and of course after that I used a water base face cleanser and the best combo.
reviews.zh: 我本來對卸妝油唔太確定，因為睇過好多人用完爆瘡，睇完所有評論之後佢哋都話呢支係最溫和嘅卸妝油之一，所以我決定試吓。我係混合性肌，完全冇爆瘡。唯一係我每星期只係用一次，做「重手」妝嘅時候用，佢會清走皮膚上所有污垢。我用暖水沖走佢，有助更徹底洗走所有產品。用完之後皮膚感覺非常軟，之後當然再用一款水基洗面奶，係最佳配搭。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Light Cleansing Oil 200mL
reviews.text:

The heavy, greasy formula clogs my pores and exacerbates my blemishes, leading to even more frustrating flare-ups. What I thought would be a soothing, hydrating experience has instead left my skin feeling congested and irritated.

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Light Cleansing Oil 200mL
reviews.text: I'm pretty particular with my cleansing oils. I've gone through quite a few. My holygrail has been the hadalabo gokujyun one. This is the most similar one I've found in terms of thinness & efficacy. I think it's really great in those regards. My 2 cons are that it doesn't wash away as well & the scent isn't my favorite. It's this odd citrus(?) scent that reminds me of those citronella bug things.
reviews.zh: 我對卸妝油好揀擇。我用過好多款。我嘅必買聖品一直係肌研極潤嗰支。呢支係我搵到嘅最相似嘅一款，喺清爽度同效果方面都係。我覺得呢兩方面真係好正。我有兩個缺點：佢唔係咁容易沖走，同埋味道唔係我杯茶。係一種好奇怪嘅柑橘（？）味，令我諗起嗰啲香茅驅蟲嘅嘢。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Light Cleansing Oil 200mL
reviews.text:
I have been using the entire Madagascar Centella line for over a month now and I can confidently say that it has changed my skin for the better. My skin’s texture is smoother, brighter and I no longer get those painful cystic acne, sometimes 1 hormonal pimple a month during my period which is manageable.

1. I double cleanse using the oil cleanser and then the ampoule foam cleanser
2. Toner
3. Ampoule 
4. Soothing cream
5. Cream
6. Sun cream (during the day)

Same routine for night time except sun cream.
reviews.zh:
我用咗成個 Madagascar Centella 系列超過一個月，我可以好有信心咁講佢令我嘅皮膚變得更好。皮膚質地更滑更亮，再冇生過嗰啲痛嘅囊腫型暗瘡，間中每個月經期生 1 粒荷爾蒙暗瘡，都仲算控制到。

1. 我用卸妝油再做雙重清潔，再用安瓶泡沫洗面奶
2. 爽膚水
3. 安瓶
4. 舒緩面霜
5. 面霜
6. 防晒（日頭用）

夜晚用同一程序，只係唔用防晒。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
